title: I WILL SING OF THE MERCIES OF THE LORD

lines.text: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord forever,
I will sing, I will sing;
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord forever,
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord.
With my mouth will I make known,
With my mouth will I make known,

chords:
[Verse 1]
[G]I will sing of the [C]mercies of the [G]Lord for[D]ever,
[G]I will sing, [D]I will [G]sing;
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord forever,
[G]I will sing of the [D]mercies of the [G]Lord.

[Verse 2]
[G]With my mouth will I [C]make [G]known,
[G]Thy faithfulness, [D]Thy faithfulness,
With my mouth will I make known,
[G]Thy faithfulness to [D]all gener[G]ations.
(Repeat first four lines)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord forever,
I will sing, I will sing;
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord forever,
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord.

[Verse 2]
With my mouth will I make known,
Thy faithfulness, Thy faithfulness,
With my mouth will I make known,
Thy faithfulness to all generations.
(Repeat first four lines)
